**Subject: October 8 Launch Position and Next Action**

Hi Avery,

I want to give you a clear update on our launch position.

The October 8 launch was tentative. The latest schedule shows the security review completing October 12 at the earliest, and release requires completed approval. No new production date is authorized yet, and the review may still require remediation.

The team has responded well. We can still hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data. That gives us a useful checkpoint while the security review continues.

Nia owns the security review. You, Avery, choose whether to accept the staging demo.

**Action needed:** Please confirm whether you accept the October 8 staging demo. Once you decide, we will align the team and keep the production path moving.

We remain confident in the team and the plan.

Best,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
